dct_description_sm: FCOVER corresponds to the amount of the ground surface that is covered by vegetation, including the understory, when viewed vertically (from nadir).  FCOVER is an indicator of the spatial extent of vegetation independent of land cover class. It is a dimensionless quantity that varies from 0 to 1, and as an intrinsic property of the canopy, is not dependent on satellite observation conditions.This product consists of FCOVER indicator during peak-season (June-July-August)  at 100m resolution covering Canada's land mass.
dct_title_s: Peak Season Fraction of Vegetation Cover of Canada from Medium Resolution Satellite Imagery
